name: Pomogi dedushke shodit' za hlebushkom
source:
Help grandpa Go Get Some Bread!

He can't do it without you. But please, no bag with milk inside the bag for milk.
Grandpa has an upset stomach from milk.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730890/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
帮助爷爷去拿点面包！

没有你他做不到。但请注意，牛奶袋内不得装有牛奶。
爷爷因牛奶而胃部不适。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730890/]Steam[/url]]
